title: Container Bookings: request admission limits by tier
content:
## Scope
This quick reference covers the Container Bookings product line of Aurelia Hanse Line and states, for each of the six booking tiers, the limits a booking request itself must fit: the channel it arrives through, the cargo handling category, the number of containers, how far ahead the requested departure may lie, and the minimum lead time before the cargo cut-off of the requested sailing.

## What each limit means
- **Allowed channels**: the channels through which the tier may be booked.
- **Allowed cargo categories**: the cargo handling categories the tier accepts.
- **Maximum containers**: the largest number of containers one booking of the tier may carry.
- **Booking window**: the furthest, in calendar days, that the requested departure may lie after the request date.
- **Minimum lead before cargo cut-off**: the minimum time, in whole hours, between the request and the cargo cut-off of the requested vessel.

## Tier table
| Tier | Allowed channels | Allowed cargo categories | Maximum containers | Booking window (calendar days) | Minimum lead before cargo cut-off (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | online portal | general | 10 | 42 | 72 |
| AHL Spot Flex | online portal, EDI | general, reefer | 20 | 42 | 48 |
| AHL Contract Booking | online portal, EDI, customer service desk | general, reefer, dangerous goods, out of gauge | 50 | 56 | 24 |
| AHL Contract Priority | online portal, EDI, customer service desk | general, reefer, dangerous goods, out of gauge | 50 | 56 | 24 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | online portal, customer service desk | general, reefer, dangerous goods | 30 | 42 | 48 |
| AHL Premium Express | online portal, EDI, customer service desk | general, reefer | 20 | 28 | 24 |

The entry gate of every one of the six tiers admits a customer whose credit standing is cash in advance or credit approved.

## Reading the table: points of judgement
**Which tiers accept out-of-gauge cargo?** Only AHL Contract Booking and AHL Contract Priority list out of gauge among their cargo categories.

**Which tiers can be booked through the customer service desk?** AHL Contract Booking, AHL Contract Priority, AHL Guaranteed Loading and AHL Premium Express. AHL Spot Saver and AHL Spot Flex list no desk channel.

**Which tier has the shortest booking window?** AHL Premium Express, at 28 calendar days; the two contract tiers have the longest, at 56.

## Hypothetical illustration
*Hypothetical request, for illustration only:* 25 reefer containers arriving by EDI.
- AHL Spot Flex: reefer and EDI are listed, but 25 exceeds its maximum of 20, so the request does not fit.
- AHL Contract Booking and AHL Contract Priority: EDI, reefer and a count up to 50 are all listed, so the request fits these limits.
- AHL Guaranteed Loading: EDI is not one of its channels, so the request does not fit.
- AHL Premium Express: 25 exceeds its maximum of 20.
- AHL Spot Saver: reefer is not accepted and 25 exceeds 10.
